metadata.description: Unified Evaluation Benchmark Suite for Critical Raw Materials Data Space (CRMsDataSpace), integrating out-of-domain guardrails, single-turn slot filling, negations, technical Q&A, boolean logic, and multi-turn conversational DST memory. Cleaned version with all queries strictly in English (query_es fields removed). Added explicit 'author_tag' attribute to every test case (author:rredondo, author:fdemiguel, author:mmanzanedo).
metadata.target_space: European Critical Raw Materials Data Space (CRMsDataSpace)
metadata.dataset_scope: 100 georeferenced synthetic European CRM extractive waste facilities across 12 EU member states
